title: Word Race
lead: Type words fast and overtake your rivals! Type a word in time and your car passes the one ahead. Run out of time and the car behind passes you. Be first across the finish line!
touchText: This game needs a physical computer or laptop keyboard. You cannot type on a phone or tablet without one.
rule1: You start 6th out of 6: five rivals are ahead of you.
rule2: Word typed in time: you pass one car. Time runs out: one car passes you.
rule3: Finish first to win three cups. Second place gives two, third gives one.
diff.easy.name: Easy
diff.easy.desc: Short words and plenty of time.
diff.medium.name: Medium
diff.medium.desc: Words get longer, time gets shorter.
diff.hard.name: Hard
resetConfirm: Reset all results of this game? This cannot be undone.
sceneAria: A track with six cars, yours is the red one with a flag. The order of the cars is shown below.
status.ready: Get ready! The race is about to start.
status.upFast: Fast! Overtake: you are now {place} of {total}.
status.lead: You are in front, keep it up!
status.miss: Time is up. You were overtaken: now {place} of {total}.
status.missLast: Time is up. You are last.
layoutHint: Switch the keyboard layout to English
res.t1: You passed every rival. Try a harder track!
res.t2: So close to winning. One more race?
res.t3: You are on the podium! A little more and you are higher.
res.tLow: No worries: you type faster with every race. Try again!
